notes.title: Gibbon: Beyond the Trees releases in physical format today
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We are partnering up with Super Rare Games to release our game Gibbon: Beyond the Trees on Nintendo Switch™ as a limited boxed version, including some really nice special items.

It will come with:
📧 Exclusive pop-out Gibbon postcard which can be hung!
📖 Extended beautiful art manual packed with the story of Gibbon, concept art & information on the NGO's!
🃏 Set of 3 Trading Card pack

😬 Only 3000 copies available.

Head over to Super Rare Games' website to get a copy:
[url=https://superraregames.com/products/srg-121-gibbon-beyond-the-trees]https://superraregames.com/products/srg-121-gibbon-beyond-the-trees[/url]

Keep swinging 🐒!

notes.title: Daily Run Leaderboard Hotfix 1.9.3
notes.content:
The last update broke leaderboard creation for Daily Runs, which caused them to appear empty for everyone. Since the run results are stored locally for a week, they can still be uploaded with this update. Just start the game and enter the Daily Run menu. Your runs from the last few days should appear on the leaderboards as usual. If you don't see them immediately, just wait for a while, go back to the main menu and re-open the Daily Run section.

Sorry for the inconvenience and thanks a lot for the continued interest in Daily Runs everyone!

notes.title: Improved Liberation mode and final polish round incoming!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We gathered the team one more time and fine-tuned all the minor aspects we were itching to make better. We also added one major feature for Liberation Mode. It was a pleasure to dive back into Gibbon with our wonderful team. We hope you enjoy this update as much as we enjoyed putting it together!

[b]Escape the new hawk-eagle:[/b]
[h2]Predator Approaching![/h2]
Can you escape the new bird of prey that hunts Lilac? Stay alert: The hawk-eagle now appears during Liberation mode and can kill our gibbons! 
Take a break in our gibbon's family tree to celebrate whenever you free 10 animals. This improves the overall rhythm of longer runs in Liberation mode. We also added some new levels, where you can slide through more industrial areas in plantation and carefully traverse an intimidating burning landfill in town.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41885703/127994a5c99b81b642ac66bf4556448fc3492b68.gif[/img]


[b]So much polish to sweeten up this update:[/b]
[h2]Shinier than ever[/h2]
Coolest addition: Humans now react to gibbons passing by! The gibbons' bounce animation got an iteration and is now snappier and more visually appealing. We've also added some cool water effects when Pink or Lilac run through shallow water. 
Additionally we've made improvements to various minor visual aspects throughout the game, making the game world even more intriguing. Lastly we've boosted the performance and optimised memory usage, making things even smoother for you. 

Keep swinging 🐒, now better than ever 💅!
- Broken Rules

[h3]Here's a full list of changes for version 1.9.2:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Five new levels to Liberation and Daily Run mode
[*] More industrial areas in plantation
[*] New achievement for escaping the hawk-eagle multiple times
[*] Many visual improvements and bug fixes
[*] Humans now react to gibbons passing by
[*] Improved bounce animation
[*] Level sections with locked Encyclopaedia entries appear more often 
[*] Happy Bouncing achievement now only needs 3 instead of 5 bounces
[*] Double backflip from crane now possible
[*] Family tree celebration whenever freeing 10 animals
[*] Cages align with sloped roofs
[*] Cool water effects when running through shallow water
[*] Squashed various minor bugs and glitches
[*] The game now starts faster when offline
[*] Performance and memory improvements
[/list]

notes.title: WDC World Oceans Day Charity Sale
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We are excited to announce that we are supporting WDC, Whale and Dolphin Conservation for World Oceans Day!   
The WDC World Oceans Day Sale starts today and runs until 15th June, 10am PDT 2023, and you can save a fin-tastic 50% off Gibbon: Beyond the Trees and its soundtrack. We will also donate 50% of our net profits to WDC to support their conservation work.* 

Their cause is very dear to our hearts so please support us and spread the word. You can find out more about WDC and their work down below.

WDC, Whale and Dolphin conservation is the leading global charity dedicated to the protection and conservation of whales and dolphins. 

Their expert-led teams in the UK, Europe, the Americas, and Australasia work across the whole spectrum of threats, from climate breakdown to accidental entanglements in fishing gear. They bring together, and work hand-in-hand with, businesses, philanthropists, scientists, NGOs, governments and grassroots communities to find solutions to the problems faced by whales and dolphins.

Their aim is to reverse the global decline in whale and dolphin populations by:
- Stopping cruelty from deliberate harms such as whaling and captivity.
- Creating safe seas, free from the threat of pollution, collisions with vessels and accidental entanglement in fishing gear.
- Winning recognition of whales and dolphins as sentient, socially complex beings, and our allies in the fight against climate and nature breakdown.

Whales and dolphins are awe-inspiring. They are intelligent beings, vital for the health of the ocean and planet. They have suffered from terrible harm - deliberate and accidental - and their homes and populations are under threat. But it's not too late. 

Together we can still help them recover and flourish and they can help us reconnect with the wild, and repair the damage we have caused. 

If you want to read more about WDC, you can do so here: https://whales.org/
You can find many other amazing games in the sale here: https://bit.ly/OceansDaySteamSale23 
Thank you for joining us and for supporting WDC! 

We very much appreciate your support 🙇‍♂️

Keep swinging 🐒 and saving 🐳 & 🐬!
- Broken Rules

*50% of our net developer revenue from this sale will support WDC, Whale and Dolphin Conservation. Whale and Dolphin Conservation is a UK registered charity (no. 1014705)

notes.title: Incoming: Encyclopedia
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

[h3]We have a new major update for [i]Gibbon: Beyond the Trees.[/i][/h3] 
We always wanted to include even [b]more real world information[/b] about gibbons, their habitat and how they are endangered. 

So with this update we are doing exactly that. We've added an [b]encyclopedia with unlockable entries[/b] which will give you more context and background information about the game's protagonists and their environment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41885703/1852e6e791c666508f82c67e02a13437a173eae4.gif[/img]
You can collect pickups in Liberation mode to unlock and read them in a nice little in-game gallery.


[h3]News on Steam Deck Compatibility:[/h3]
We have also been working on making [i]Gibbon: Beyond the Trees[/i] fully Steam Deck compatible. It is not yet officially verified but you can already play it very nicely on the system with this update.


There is also some additional content and some more improvements coming alongside this update. See all of them in detail down below.

[h3]Steam Developer Site:[/h3]
Broken Rules does now have a [b]developer site here on Steam[/b] where you can [b]follow us[/b] and get all the updates on our studio and games.
[b]Go and check it out! [/b]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/brokenrules]https://store.steampowered.com/developer/brokenrules[/url]


Keep swinging 🐒, and reading 📔,
- Broken Rules



[b]Here's a full list of changes for version 1.7.1:[/b]
[list]
[*] New achievement [i]Bookworm[/i] related to the encyclopedia
[*] Added a new story moment after the hunt
[*] Added new levels to Liberation and Daily Run mode
[list]
[*] Can you make it through fires within trees?
[*] Cross a river over a big logging boat!
[/list]
[*] Improvements for Steam Deck compatibility:
[list]
[*] Proper touch navigation for menus
[*] Display the right controller buttons (also for various controllers on desktops)
[/list]
[*] Many minor improvements and bug fixes 
[/list]

notes.title: Daily Runs incoming!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

You helped us a lot during the last few weeks to make this new game mode rock solid. Big shoutout to everyone who has joined our beta for daily runs. Thank you so much!

Now it is time to set it live for all of you: 
[b]Introducing [i]Gibbon: Beyond the Trees[/i]' third game mode: [/b]

[h2]Daily Run[/h2]
Race against each other and enter the leaderboards!
We hope you like it and will have a lot of fun with this new mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41885703/632974d80dd9367c425a992dba8c5709d00a2ca9.gif[/img]
Who will make it the furthest in the given time, who will be the fastest gibbon of the day?

[b]There's another feature to sweeten up this update:[/b]
[h2]Steam Cloud Support[/h2]
We now sync your progress in the game to all the devices you use Steam on. As from today, you can pick up your current progress wherever you play. Should you already have started the game on a different device or use more than one profile – these will all be kept and synced in the future.

Keep swinging 🐒, now as fast as you can 🏁!
- Broken Rules

[h3]Here's a full list of changes for version 1.6.2:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Daily Runs are now available when you completed the story
[list]
[*] New procedural level every day! Same for everyone.
[*] Compete with players from all over the world on the leaderboards!
[*] 4 new achievements related to the new game mode
[/list]
[*] Game progress is now syncronized via Steam Cloud
[*] When playing with a controller, we now show the buttons in game stylized for the most common controllers.
[*] The default language (used when first starting the game, or creating a new profile) can now be overridden [url=https://help.steampowered.com/en/faqs/view/4984-c127-121d-b3f2]in the game's language preferences[/url].
[/list]

notes.title: Game Update and Fixes 1.5.4
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We have been working on new features and fixes since we launched our ecological Adventure [i]Gibbon: Beyond the Trees[/i] a few weeks ago. 

Some [b]new content[/b] has been added and [b]performance- and general issues have been fixed[/b]. See the full details below.


[b]Update log:[/b]
– Made the crane needed for the [i]Canabalt[/i] achievement appear more often and easier to reach
– Lot’s of performance improvements during gameplay
– Improved performance drops from world generation
– Added new logging levels to Liberation
– Added new backgrounds to Story mode to tell more about the destruction of our gibbons’ habitat
– Improved clouds and lighting
– Fixed background glitches in Liberation mode
– Use mouse gestures to backflip or drop-down


We hope you like these updates! There is also a new mode we will soon introduce. You can try it already in BETA. Just have a look at the other news beat we will be sharing today.

Keep swinging 🐒
Broken Rules
